summary: The school district expresses a strong need for E-Rate funding to maintain network connectivity for student instruction and opposes any sunset or restrictions on the program.

claims.argument: As a small/medium rural K-12 school district, we are not able to self fund necessary network connectivity for student instruction. It would be catastrophic for us to lose this funding. Thank you for your consideration.
claims.evidence_quote: Please preserve all E-Rate Funding. As a small/medium rural K-12 school district, we are not able to self fund necessary network connectivity for student instruction. It would be catastrophic for us to lose this funding. Thank you for your consideration.
